text_block_list.text:
One day, Win Variation invited me to watch 
a ballet performance together.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The lead's expressiveness was absolutely 
overwhelming! The character's emotions hit 
me directly...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah! I was deeply moved the whole 
time...!

Yeah! I was deeply moved the whole 
time...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Watching that dance reminded me of the 
expression techniques I learned in ballet 
back then... It might be great reference 
for the ad-lib part of the live 
performance."

She said she was agonizing over the ad-lib 
choreography for the concert. That's why 
she seems to have come to watch the ballet 
in search of a breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Convey emotion not just through your 
movements, but with your expression too. 
My dad used to teach me that all the time.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"So, I thought if I could at least be 
expressive in my face, the dancing might 
look more natural..."
choice_data_list:
Exactly! Well then, shall we practice a 
little?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Practice my facial expressions...? 
W-Well then... here's a refreshing smile.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...*smiles*

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! I knew it, no good! Even in ballet, 
emotional expression is my weak point... 
It always ends up looking so unnatural~!

However, unlike ballet, a live concert 
doesn't require telling a story. When it 
comes to emotional expression in a 
concert—
choice_data_list:
How about putting your feelings for the 
fans into it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I see... My feelings for the fans. ...If 
that's what it takes, I might be able to 
do it. I'll think about it.

Later on, Win Variation asked me to take a 
look at some ad-lib choreography.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's start from a little 
earlier, then!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Phew...! How was that, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: It's fine, you were definitely smiling!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: For real?! Heheh, what a relief...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
What feelings I want to convey to my 
fans... ...I've tried imagining myself 
standing on the stage over and over again.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy! I want to wave back at them! 
I want to shout 'thank you!'

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"My heart was so full of those feelings... 
that I couldn't help but smile, y'know."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Finding my own way to express it is still 
hard for me... But—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"If it's just standing on stage with my 
true, honest feelings, I can do that!"
choice_data_list: How about practicing low-angle shots next?

Let's think more about arranging the 
choreography too!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hype up the fans...? Right, I'll keep 
going like this.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The concert isn't over yet! I want to hear 
everyone's voices even more!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...W-What do you think?

While not flashy, her words conveyed her 
characteristic earnestness. Her fans would 
surely appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! First off, I'll try changing how I 
move my hands.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Conveying my feelings to the fans... If I 
were to express it through movement—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did I do it...?! Heheh, let's keep 
training like this!
